I’m so glad we found Jay’s Puppy Ranch!

My dog is very particular, and I’ll be the first to admit that she is not always the most well-behaved when it comes to grooming. We had even been told this by other places. After seeing a post for Jay’s Puppy Ranch at our veterinarian’s office, we decided to give them a try—and I’m so glad we did.

My dog actually looks forward to going! She’s excited when we arrive, and when she comes home, she has such a warm, happy disposition. They’ve figured out how to work with her temperament and cut her hair in a way that works best for her while still making her look cute for me. 😂 Somehow, she behaves really well for them!

What I especially love is that Jay’s Puppy Ranch doesn’t have that big-box-business feeling. It’s right here in the neighborhood, it’s personable, and it gives me that hometown feeling of supporting a neighbor doing something they love while also taking great care of my dog.

If you have a dog who is particular, nervous, or maybe hasn’t done well with groomers in the past, I would definitely give Jay’s Puppy Ranch a try.

I happily recommend them—and apparently, my dog does too. 🐾❤️

I recently took my dog to The Puppy Ranch for grooming, and I can’t express how incredible the entire experience was. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and heard. I had specific requests for my dog’s grooming, and they not only delivered exactly what I asked for, but they exceeded every expectation I had. They went above and beyond by adding complimentary services—completely surprising me. Not only did they do a fantastic job with the grooming, but they also included teeth cleaning at no extra charge. On top of that, I had initially expected just a standard nail trim, but since it was my first visit, they surprised me with nail buffing to make sure everything was smooth and polished. It really showed how much they care about their customers and their pets.

What truly amazed me is that after my first visit, they explained that every Monday, I’ll get a 25% discount on future services for my pets. The fact that they offer this after your first service is such a great incentive, and I’m definitely planning to come back on a Monday to take advantage of it. Even though it’s only on Mondays, that 25% off is a huge deal, and it’s just another example of how they treat their customers with care.

I can’t recommend The Puppy Ranch enough to anyone looking for top-notch grooming. They treated me like family, and I feel confident that I’ve found my go-to place. I know I’ll be a loyal customer for a long time. If I could give them a 100 out of 10, I absolutely would. They’ve earned my trust and my repeat visits, and I can’t wait to come back.
